differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with microalbuminuria, high urine protein and reduced GFR consistent with diabetic kidney disease.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Essential hypertension present; proteinuria and CKD stage 3a can result from chronic pressure‑related renal injury.

differential.name: Analgesic (NSAID) nephropathy
differential.rationale: Chronic low back/neck pain suggests regular NSAID use, a known cause of interstitial nephritis and CKD with proteinuria.

differential.name: Primary glomerulonephritis (e.g., IgA nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Significant proteinuria with relatively preserved serum albumin could reflect an underlying glomerular disease independent of diabetes/hypertension.

differential.name: Obstructive uropathy
differential.rationale: Possible silent obstruction contributing to elevated creatinine, though no imaging or symptoms reported, making it less likely.
